- Java SDK: initial integration checklist done (auth adapter integrated). Need EdgePayments staging token to validate streaming frames and sample rate (blocked).
- Node SDK: small schema mismatch on metadata header (we'll push a patch by EOD Thursday).
- API contract: endpoints documented in the MAP sheet; plan to run a contract test on 01/25.
- Blockers: IP allowlist + staging token; CORS headers for merchant dashboard (EdgePayments infra).

Action items I plan to own this week:
- Push Node SDK patch and publish 0.3.1 (dev_patel) — ETA 01/15
- Run contract test with sample payloads (dev_patel) — ETA 01/25

If EdgePayments can share a sample stream (even a short 60s capture) that would let us validate end-to-end latency and KV cache sizing.

—Dev (Dev Patel)

Subject: Notes and action items: MAP checkpoint (15 Jan)

Thanks everyone for the call — below are the meeting notes and agreed owners. I captured the decisions and open risks so we have a single source of truth.

Meeting notes (short):
- Quick demo of streaming throughput (redwood staging) — looked good at small scale, need EdgePayments stream to finalize numbers.
- Auth flow: EdgePayments will provide a staging token and allowlist by EOD Friday (Monica to confirm).
- Tool calling: Karthik to demo a mini POC next week (02/26 internal demo was a typo; updated target: 01/26 internal, 02/09 customer).

Action items (owner — ETA):
1) EdgePayments to send staging token + allowlist IPs — owner: Oliver / Bethany — ETA: 2026-01-16 (OVERDUE)
2) Node SDK patch and publish 0.3.1 — owner: Dev Patel — ETA: 2026-01-15 (IN PROGRESS)
3) Streaming test payloads (60–120s capture) — owner: EdgePayments — ETA: 2026-01-16
4) Contract test run (internal) — owner: Dev Patel — ETA: 2026-01-25
5) Security pre-fill for SOC2 (first pass) — owner: Rachel Kim — ETA: 2026-01-20

Open risks:
- If staging token is delayed >3 business days, streaming validation will slide and push the customer POC by ~2 weeks.
- Allowlist rules may require coordination with merchant infra (EdgePayments) — risk needs early engagement.

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with the above and tag owners. Next checkpoint set for Thursday, 22 Jan at 10am PT.

—Mina
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Oliver

Great — thanks for the token and payloads, Oliver. Quick status update and next steps so the MAP stays actionable: 

Status snapshot (18 Jan):
- SDK Java: integrated and smoke-tested on our staging; Node SDK patch released 0.3.1 (dev_patel) — DONE
- Auth + allowlist: staging token received; allowlist ticket created — Monica is validating connectivity this week — owner: monica_patel — ETA: 01/20
- Streaming latency tests: we will run the 60s synthetic dataset you sent with our harness. Owner: mina_haddad — ETA: 01/21 for initial numbers; we will provide 95th percentile latency and CPU/GPU utilization.
- Tool calling POC: internal demo scheduled for 01/26 — owner: karthik_iyer — action: Karthik to send invite and agenda by 01/20.

Confirmed acceptance criteria additions: 95th percentile <= 200ms at simulated 1k TPS. We'll run both in-region and cross-region tests and report the difference. If the 95th percentile is >200ms on our baseline, we'll propose batching/quantization adjustments and re-run.

Next checkpoint: Thu 2026-01-22 10:00am PT — calendar invite to follow. If any of the owners see blockers, escalate to me directly.

Thanks all —
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
